Message.Name: Signon In Message
Message.Description: Logs the user on to the drop copy feed

Field.Name: Password
Field.Description: Password entered by the user; alphabet, numbers and special characters are allowed

Message.Name: Sign On Out Message
Message.Description: Confirms the logon. Alpha Char carries the number of streams the drop copy feed is sent from, one download request being needed per stream. On an error the same transaction code carries the Error Response layout instead, distinguished only by a non zero Error Code

Field.Name: Password
Field.Description: Password entered by the user; alphabet, numbers and special characters are allowed

Message.Name: Heartbeat Message
Message.Description: Keeps the connection alive during periods of inactivity. Carries the Message Header alone

Message.Name: Dc Download Request Message
Message.Description: Requests the trade download for one stream, named in the first byte of Alpha Char, from the time given in Sequence Number

Field.Name: SequenceNumber
Field.Description: Time the last message was received by the user, taken from Time Stamp 1 of the last trade confirmation; zero to retrieve from the beginning of the trading day

Field.Name: ResponseOrderNumber
Field.Description: Order number of the order taking part in the trade

Field.Name: BuySell
Field.Description: Whether the order taking part is a buy or a sell

Field.Name: DisclosedVolRemaining
Field.Description: Disclosed volume remaining after the trade

Field.Name: Gtd
Field.Description: Number of days for a GTD order

Field.Name: FillPrice
Field.Description: Price at which the order traded, to be divided by 10000000 to get the price in rupees

Field.Name: OpOrderNumber
Field.Description: Order number on the counter party side

Field.Name: OpBrokerId
Field.Description: Trading member Id of the counter party

Field.Name: Reserved 131
Field.Description: Padding, the specification lists no field at this offset

Field.Name: OpenClose
Field.Description: Whether the trade opens or closes a position

Field.Name: Reserved 167
Field.Description: Padding, the specification lists no field at this offset

Field.Name: ADDITIONAL_ORDER_FLAGS
Field.Description: Further terms attached to the order

Field.Name: GiveUpTrade
Field.Description: Whether the trade is a give up

Field.Name: Algo ID
Field.Description: Algo Id issued by the exchange, zero for a non algo order

Field.Name: LastActivityReference
Field.Description: Unique value for the activity, currently in nanoseconds

Field.Name: NnfField
Field.Description: Fifteen digit unique identifier for the product
